programs.title: Incredible Animal Journeys
programs.desc:
The authors of the six-episode series recorded the migrations of wild inhabitants of various corners of the globe, who cover huge distances in search of food, shelter or a partner to extend the continuity of the species.Animals travel hundreds of kilometers along centuries-old routes, using the Earth's magnetic field, stars, the Moon, ocean currents and natural senses on land and in the sea.Most of them go on amazing journeys many times during their lives.However, the biggest challenge is the first expedition, which is the most dangerous for inexperienced people.Jeremy Renner will talk about this unique adventure.Viewers will have the chance to see the majestic processions of zebras, whose migrations are considered one of the largest land migrations on the Blue Planet.Breathtaking photos will also allow you to admire elephants trying to find water during the drought disaster
Over the course of several seasons, the film crew recorded migrations of wild inhabitants from various corners of the globe, who cover huge distances in search of food, shelter, water or a partner to extend the continuity of the species.Animals often travel hundreds of kilometers along routes known for centuries, using the Earth's magnetic field, stars, the Moon, ocean currents and natural senses.They wander over land, flow through vast oceans, long rivers and cover endless air spaces. Most of them make these exciting journeys many times during their lives.The most difficult first time The greatest challenge is the first expedition, which is full of many unpleasant surprises for inexperienced people.It happens that it is also the last one for them.A real school of life awaits novices.In the first episode, we will learn about the fate of a zebra foal taking its first steps to take part in the largest land migration of animals on the Blue Planet.Breathtaking photos will also show elephants trying to find water during a drought.The smallest of them are most at risk of dehydration, but the adults, led by the experienced grandmother elephant, do everything to ensure that the little ones survive the endless journey through the sun-burnt savannah.
